scene:
TWO separate illustrations side by side on one page, divided by a single hard straight black ink border ruled exactly down the vertical middle of the image from top edge to bottom edge. The two illustrations do not bleed into each other and there is no margin around the outside of the page.

LEFT panel: a person kneeling barefoot in a wide meadow of impossibly vivid green grass, seen from behind and slightly above so their face is not visible, one hand resting flat on the grass — the grass around their hand glowing faintly, as if warmth and affection were coming up out of it into them.

RIGHT panel: an extreme close-up of one single blade of grass held upright between two fingertips, the blade blazing with contained light far too bright for the ordinary dim landscape behind it.

No text or lettering anywhere.

FOUR separate illustrations on one page in a 2x2 grid, divided by single hard straight black ink borders ruled exactly down the vertical middle and across the horizontal middle of the image, edge to edge. The illustrations do not bleed into each other and there is no margin around the outside of the page.

TOP LEFT panel: a person kneeling barefoot in a wide meadow of impossibly vivid green grass, seen from behind and slightly above so their face is not visible, one hand resting flat on the grass — the grass around their hand glowing faintly, as if warmth and affection were coming up out of it into them.

TOP RIGHT panel: an extreme close-up of one single blade of grass held upright between two fingertips, the blade blazing with contained light far too bright for the ordinary dim landscape behind it.

BOTTOM LEFT panel: a rolling green hillside where everything is visibly alive and breathing — the grass leaning and stirring, scattered stones each glowing with a slow inner pulse, the hills rising and settling like the flank of a sleeping animal, no people.

BOTTOM RIGHT panel: a garden seen close and low: wildflowers, grass and the trunks of trees, each one lit from the inside so the light comes out through the petals and the blades and the bark rather than falling on them from a sky.

No text or lettering anywhere.
